edits:
def forward(self, h, e):
        scale, shift = self.film(e).chunk(2, dim=1)
        update = self.net(h) * (1.0 + scale) + shift
        if self.training:
            keep = (torch.rand(h.shape[0], 1, device=h.device) > 0.1).to(h.dtype)
            return h + update * keep / 0.9
        return h + update

        flip = torch.rand(x1.shape[0], device=device) < 0.5
        if flip.any():
            pairs = [0, 2, 1, 4, 3, 6, 5, 8, 7, 10, 9, 12, 11, 14, 13, 16, 15]
            kp = c[:, :34].reshape(-1, 17, 2)
            kp[flip, :, 0] = 1.0 - kp[flip, :, 0]
            c[:, :34] = kp[:, pairs, :].reshape(-1, 34)
            c[flip, 51] = 1.0 - c[flip, 51]
            pose = x1.reshape(-1, 17, 3)
            pose[flip, :, 0] = -pose[flip, :, 0]
            x1 = pose[:, pairs, :].reshape(-1, 51)
